pages.text: The final machine. It slowly draws three ingredients together into one, with $(thing)no fuel$(). Each takes 40 seconds.

$(li)One ingredient goes in each slot, in any order.$(li)Ingredients with a quality must all share it, and the result keeps it.$(li)Taking one out starts over.$(li)Hoppers feed each arm from its side and the top from above, and take the result out below.
